# 06 – Memory, Tasks & Projects

## Memory System

David AI maintains two complementary memory layers:

### Short-Term Memory
- Active conversation context
- Temporary reasoning context
- Session state
- Cleared automatically when appropriate

### Long-Term Memory
- User preferences
- Assistant preferences
- Approved personal context
- Project knowledge
- Workflow knowledge
- Saved conversations
- Custom notes

Users can:
- Create memories
- Edit memories
- Search memories
- Delete memories
- Disable memory
- Export and import memory

## Task Management

Support:
- Create tasks
- Edit tasks
- Delete tasks
- Complete tasks
- Priorities
- Due dates
- Categories
- Labels
- Recurring tasks
- Reminders
- Search and filters

Statuses:
- Pending
- In Progress
- Waiting
- Completed
- Cancelled
- Failed

## Project Management

Projects contain:
- Name
- Description
- Goals
- Milestones
- Tasks
- Activity
- Files
- Notes
- Status

Users can:
- Create
- Rename
- Archive
- Delete
- Share (where supported)
- Track progress

## Activity Timeline

Record important events:
- Conversations
- Memory updates
- Task changes
- Project updates
- AI tool usage
- Website deployments
- Video generation jobs

## Knowledge Search

Provide fast semantic and keyword search across:
- Memories
- Conversations
- Projects
- Tasks
- Documents

## Privacy & Security

- All data is user-scoped
- Authorization enforced
- Memory deletion is permanent unless backups are enabled
- Sensitive actions are logged
